title: Chance and Experiments
summary: The probability scale, experiments with dice and coins, and why more trials give better estimates.
objectives: I can place events on the probability scale from 0 to 1.
I can find experimental probabilities from data.
I can explain why results get closer to theory with more trials.
misconceptions: If a 6 came up 4 times in 10 rolls, the die must be unfair.
A probability can be more than 1.
